new_learnings.text: Narrow rally detected: all 4 major indices green (+0.56% to +4.78%) but Up/Down ratio is 0.58:1 with 63% of stocks declining. The index-level strength masks broad market weakness — this is concentrated in mega-cap tech/semis. The breadth below 1:1 triggers the hard no-new-positions rule per the minimum buy gate.
new_learnings.mechanism: When indices are lifted by a narrow set of large-cap stocks while the broad market deteriorates, new entries face elevated whipsaw risk — the rally lacks participation and can reverse quickly. Cash preservation is the correct stance.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance anti-chase filter eliminates ~70% of today's 29 enriched candidates. The stocks being eliminated (芯碁微装 +11.1%, 联瑞新材 +21.2%, 国瓷材料 +11.6%) are the exact type V1 bought and lost money on. This filter is the single most effective gate for preventing FOMO entries.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that have spiked 10%+ above MA5 are in a mean-reversion danger zone — the probability of a pullback in the next 3-5 days is high. Waiting for the pullback to MA5/MA10 support dramatically improves risk/reward.

new_learnings.text: 华锡有色 锡/算力金属 catalyst is genuine (连续异常波动公告, 小金属板块拉升) but the stock is severely overextended (dist_ma5=12.6%, dist_ma10=16.6%). A good catalyst does not justify chasing an overextended price. The same lesson applies to 联瑞新材 and 国瓷材料 — all have real catalysts but prices have run too far.
new_learnings.mechanism: Catalyst strength determines direction; MA distance determines timing. Confusing the two leads to buying right before a pullback.

new_learnings.text: 华丰科技 has a massive 解禁 event on June 29 (61% of total shares, 2.79亿股). Regardless of the 铜缆高速连接 narrative strength, this event risk is too large for a momentum position. The stock could gap down significantly on or before the unlock date.
new_learnings.mechanism: 解禁 events >30% of float create structural selling pressure that overwhelms short-term momentum signals. The market prices in the unlock weeks ahead.
